content.title: Chapter 1 - GENERAL PROVISIONS — Sec. 1-15. - History notes.
content.summary:
The history notes appearing in parentheses after sections of this Code are not intended
               to have any legal effect, but are merely intended to indicate the source of matter
               contained in the section.
